mapper.select: SELECT i.id AS identity_id, i.identity_type AS identity_type, i.nickname AS nickname, i.avatar_url AS avatar_url, i.timezone AS timezone, o.id AS org_id, o.name AS org_name, o.logo_url AS org_logo_url, d.name AS department_name, m.member_key AS member_key, m.org_role AS org_role FROM identity i LEFT JOIN organization o ON o.id = i.org_id AND o.deleted_at IS NULL LEFT JOIN org_member m ON m.identity_id = i.id AND m.org_id = i.org_id AND m.status <> 'LEFT' LEFT JOIN department d ON d.id = m.department_id WHERE i.account_id = #{accountId} AND i.status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY i.identity_type, o.id
